title: Fact grain, dimensions and joins
summary: State what one fact row represents before drawing the star.

claims.text: A star schema organizes measures in fact tables and descriptive context in dimensions. Fact grain must be defined.

levels.overview: Explain sales by customer and date.
levels.architecture: Draw FactSales, DimCustomer and DimDate, with keys and one declared fact grain.
levels.detail: Inspect two order-line rows, key uniqueness and a join that accidentally multiplies totals.

example.input: Synthetic lines L1: 2 units at 10; L2: 1 unit at 15.
steps: Declare one row per order line.
Join to one matching customer version and one date.
example.output: Two rows and sales of 35 synthetic currency units.
limits: The value is fixture arithmetic, not business evidence.
A missing or nonunique dimension match must remain visible.
